bio: Kayla Julianna Carabes (b. 2002 Houston, TX) is a multidisciplinary artist working across painting and design with a focus on natural environments as sites of memory, transformation, and storytelling. Kayla earned her BFA in Painting from Rhode Island School of Design in Providence, RI and currently resides and works in Seattle Washington.
